title: 4J Tunes
description: Mimics the music player found in Minecraft: Legacy Console Edition
body:
Mimics the music player found in Minecraft: Legacy Console Edition. 

How the music works:

- Survival/Creative/Menu music: All combined to play in the same playlist
- Nether music: Only nether music
- End music: Only end music

This only changes what music is allowed in certain scenerios in the game. If you want the music to play more often like in LCE, check out [this](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/reduced-music-delay) mod.
